body:
I have used many drugs
and am a daily pot user.  Amanitas are no doubt one of my favorite.  They feel so natural and normal.
The buzz is like a mix of pot and alcohol, with hallucinations, without any of the side effects (when taken right).  Increased self-confidence, euphoria, with blurred vision, no paranoia or nausea (after a few drags of pot).
I take roughly 7 grams of grade 'A' Amanitas and crush then with my hands into a large bottle.  Pour 500ml boiling water over them and stir every 10 minutes for about 30-60 minutes.  Then strain the mixture into a small pot using a cloth (I used a clean sock).  Take the pulp and lightly simmer it with one tea bag, one lime, and 1-2 tablespoons of honey for about 30 minutes.  Strain the mixture into the bottle with the previous mixture and shake.  Let it cool and drink.
Weed is an absolute must for me to kill the nausea (when I get it), but it all depends on the person I guess...
